description: Operate coderamp-labs/gitingest, the MIT-licensed tool that turns a Git repository or local directory into one prompt-friendly text digest (summary, directory tree, file contents, token estimate) through the `gitingest` CLI, the Python `ingest` API, the hosted gitingest.com site, or a self-hosted FastAPI server. Use when the user names gitingest or gitingest.com, wants to replace "hub" with "ingest" in a GitHub URL, or needs a whole-repository digest to paste into an LLM, with include or exclude patterns, size limits, a branch or subdirectory, or a private-repository token. Decide local CLI versus hosted site first. Do not use for repository-aware coding, semantic search of a codebase, or digesting a tree that contains secrets. Triggers on: gitingest, git ingest, hub to ingest, repo to prompt, 깃허브 코드 전체를 프롬프트로, 코드베이스 텍스트 덤프, digest.txt.
